objective: Determine whether one later receiver obtains a second ordinary receipt from repeated actions on the original sender marks and what its complete local history then tells it.
status: Closed. A second change cannot reach the same ordinary receiver after its first receipt under either law. Independent scientific referee pending.
stop_rule: A distinct continuous receipt and its exact joint law through the frozen bound, or the first proved obstruction for each law.
title: Can one later knot receive the same send twice?
